assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks, raising concern for underlying arrhythmia.
Given the diagnosis of sick sinus syndrome, a cardiac event monitor is ordered to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances and evaluate for potential embolic sources.
The diagnosis is sick sinus syndrome.
A cardiac event monitor (CPT 93271) is ordered.
The associated diagnosis codes are G45.9 and R00.2.
The denial is under Reason Code PR-204.
